title: #192 Reasons of Attending College
prompt: People attend college or university for many different reasons (for example, new experiences, career preparation, or knowledge). Why do you think people attend college or university? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

promptSegments.text: People attend college or university for many different reasons (for example, new experiences, career preparation, or knowledge).
Why do you think people attend college or university?
Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: College helps people learn new things.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: College helps people learn new things.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: College helps people find better jobs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: College helps people find better jobs.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: College is not the only way to find a good job; practical skills and trades are valuable alternatives.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: College is not the only way to find a good job; practical skills and trades are valuable alternatives.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Learning skills outside of school is very helpful for a career because it provides practical experience.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning skills outside of school is very helpful for a career because it provides practical experience.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: College helps people gain valuable skills for their future jobs, such as learning time management and communication through group projects, which improves job prospects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: College helps people gain valuable skills for their future jobs, such as learning time management and communication through group projects, which improves job prospects.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: University offers a chance to meet new people and build a social life by interacting with diverse backgrounds and joining clubs, leading to increased confidence and independent living.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: University offers a chance to meet new people and build a social life by interacting with diverse backgrounds and joining clubs, leading to increased confidence and independent living.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Higher education equips students with practical skills, such as using specific software, making them better prepared for their careers.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Higher education equips students with practical skills, such as using specific software, making them better prepared for their careers.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: College offers opportunities to build social networks by meeting new people and forming connections through group projects and campus clubs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: College offers opportunities to build social networks by meeting new people and forming connections through group projects and campus clubs.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
